decisions.reason: The spring-controlled flap weir is close to the firm's core hydraulic steelwork offer, so it costs little to keep, and one year on the market is too short to show a shortfall against aspirations that would trigger problemistic search.

The energy management system fits the firm's strategic direction toward digital networking and energy recovery, and slack from its established municipal business lets it carry a product whose results are still uncertain, despite the earlier drop of the related fouling products.

The overflow flap gate is a multi-model product line with its own web page and lies close to the core offer, which signals commitment and likely meets aspirations, so dropping it within the year is unlikely.
